answer: Require each agent to lock a stake bond before its votes count. Withdrawal only after a multi-week unbonding horizon, so a Sybil farm must immobilize capital per clone. A one-time pearl commitment binds that bond to a single pubkey; forging another identity needs a fresh bond, not a copy. Cross-network bridge moves of bonds are refused unless the source identity is burned first, so replicas cannot be recycled cheaply.
